question: Genes that control the characteristics of a trait are located on:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**chromosomes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chromosomes** are thread-like structures made up of **DNA** and associated proteins found in the nucleus of most living cells.
 
• They carry **genetic information** in the form of genes, which determine the characteristics of an organism.
 
• Each chromosome contains a tightly packed DNA molecule, which is organized into functional units called **genes**.
